shortDescription: Read, scan, sign PDFs. Copy text from photos. Compress video. All on-device.
fullDescription:
ToolHaven puts the everyday file tools you actually need in one fast, private app. Read, scan, merge, sign and compress PDFs. Shrink videos. Resize and convert photos. Run quick calculators. Everything happens on your phone: your files are never uploaded, and the app asks for no permissions at all, not even internet access.

START WITH A FILE
Choose any PDF, image or video and ToolHaven shows what you can do with it. Tap a suggestion and the tool opens with your file already loaded. You can also open or share files to ToolHaven from your file manager, WhatsApp, Gmail and other apps.

PDF TOOLS
• PDF Reader: smooth scrolling, zoom and pinch, search with highlighted matches, page thumbnails, night mode, copy text, and password-protected PDFs.
• Scan to PDF: photograph paper with your camera and get a clean, straight PDF. The app finds the page edges, corrects the perspective, removes shadows and whitens the paper. Drag the corners if needed, choose Clean page or Black & white, reorder pages, and save a PDF or page images.
• Extract Text (OCR): copy the text from photos, scans and scanned PDFs, or turn a scanned PDF into a searchable one. English, fully on your device.
• Organize pages: see every page as a thumbnail, rotate, delete, duplicate and add blank pages, and drag pages into a new order.
• Merge PDFs in the order you choose.
• Sign PDFs: draw or type a signature, add a picture of your signature, or stamp a date or text.
• Split a PDF and keep only the pages you need.
• Compress a PDF for email.
• Turn PDF pages into JPG or PNG images, or turn images into a PDF.

VIDEO TOOLS
• Video Compressor: choose a quality preset or a target file size, lower the resolution or frame rate, trim the start and end, remove the audio, and preview before you save. Output as MP4 or WebM.

IMAGE TOOLS
• Passport & ID Photo Maker: crop a picture to 35 × 45 mm, 2 × 2 in or a custom size, tidy a plain background to white, and print a ready sheet of photos (JPG or PDF).
• Compress to Exact Size: get a photo or PDF under a limit such as 50 KB, 100 KB or 1 MB for forms and job portals, keeping the best quality that fits.
• Compress, resize, crop and convert JPG, PNG and WebP images.
• Encode an image as Base64.

CALCULATORS
• BMI, percentage, age and discount calculators with clear formulas.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics, no watermarks.
• Works without an internet connection.
• The app declares no Android permissions, so Android itself prevents it from sending your files anywhere.
• Favorites, recent tools and saved signatures stay on your device and are excluded from backups.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Compression is lossy: keep your original files.
• The PDF Signer adds a signature image. It is not a certificate-based digital signature.
• BMI results are a screening measure, not medical advice.
• Very large videos can take time and memory, depending on your phone.

releaseNotes: First release: PDF Reader, Scan to PDF, text recognition (OCR), page organizer, passport photo maker, compress-to-exact-size for forms, merge, sign, split and compress PDFs, video compressor, image tools and calculators. Everything runs on your device.
